question: Where and in what manner should the nine vowels be ritually placed?
premises: Placement locations include the head and brahma-aperture
inference: The nine vowels should be placed in sequence on the head and in the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The distribution of nine vowels across the named locations is not fully detailed in this verse.
plain_english: One should place the nine vowels in order on the head and in the brahma-randhra.
